description: Avg_CTR_Pct is stored as a percentage in 6 of 8 rows (e.g. 3.8 meaning 3.8%), but rows 3 (Display Ads) and 7 (Content Marketing) store raw fractions: 0.004 and 0.055, which are 100× smaller than the correct values of 0.4% and 5.5%. To fix: multiply these two values by 100.
business_context: Digital marketing channel benchmarks. CTR unit inconsistency causes budget optimisation models to massively underestimate click-through performance for Display and Content channels.
